sections.title: PawSharp.Client
sections.content:
PawSharp.Client

Lightweight fluent builder that wires up a fully-configured without requiring the Microsoft DI container. For ASP.NET Core or similar host-based applications prefer the services.AddPawSharp(options) extension method instead.

sections.title: PawSharp.Client.DiscordClientIntentValidationExtensions
sections.content:
PawSharp.Client.DiscordClientIntentValidationExtensions

Methods

ValidateIntents(DiscordClient client, GatewayIntents enabledIntents)

Validates that all registered gateway event handlers have their required intents enabled. Logs warnings for any mismatches and collects detailed validation results.

ParameterDescription
clientThe Discord client
enabledIntentsThe intents that are currently enabled

Returns: A summary of intent validation issues (empty if all valid)

GetRecommendedIntents(DiscordClient client)

Gets the recommended set of intents based on all currently registered handlers. Useful for suggesting minimal working intent configuration.

ParameterDescription
clientThe Discord client

Returns: Recommended intents, or (GatewayIntents)0 if no handlers are registered

LogIntentSummary(DiscordClient client, GatewayIntents enabledIntents)

Logs a summary of which intents are currently enabled and which are recommended. Useful for debugging intent configuration at startup.

ParameterDescription
clientThe Discord client
enabledIntentsThe intents that are currently enabled

sections.title: PawSharp.Client.Extensions.PawSharpServiceCollectionExtensions
sections.content:
PawSharp.Client.Extensions.PawSharpServiceCollectionExtensions

Methods

AddPawSharp(IServiceCollection services, PawSharpOptions options, Func<IServiceProvider, IEntityCache> cacheFactory)

Registers all PawSharp services — REST client, gateway, cache, interaction handler, and — with the supplied service collection using the provided options.

ParameterDescription
servicesThe service collection to register into.
optionsBot configuration (token, intents, etc.).
cacheFactoryOptional factory for supplying a custom implementation. When null, the in-memory provider from PawSharp.Cache is expected to be registered separately (e.g. via services.AddMemoryCache()).

Returns: The same for chaining.

AddPawSharpWithMemoryCache()

Registers all PawSharp services with an in-memory entity cache. Equivalent to calling with cacheFactory: _ => new MemoryCacheProvider().

sections.title: PawSharp.Client.PawSharpClientBuilder
sections.content:
PawSharp.Client.PawSharpClientBuilder

Methods

WithToken()

Sets the bot token. Must start with Bot (Discord format). If you provide a raw token without the prefix, the prefix is added automatically.

WithIntents()

Sets the gateway intents to subscribe to.

AddIntents()

Adds additional intents to the current set.

WithApiVersion()

Sets the Discord API version to use (default: 10).

WithSharding(int shardId, int totalShards)

Configures sharding for large bots (> ~2 500 guilds).

ParameterDescription
shardIdZero-based index of this shard.
totalShardsTotal number of shards across all instances.

UseCompression()

Enables zlib gateway compression (reduces bandwidth on large bots).

UseLoggerFactory()

Supplies a custom for all PawSharp components.

UseConsoleLogging(LogLevel minimumLevel)

Configures PawSharp to write logs to Console.Out at the specified minimum level.

ParameterDescription
minimumLevelMinimum level to log (default: ).

UseMemoryCache()

Uses the built-in in-memory cache (default behaviour when no cache is specified).

UseCache()

Supplies a custom implementation.

UseHttpClient()

Supplies a custom for the REST layer (e.g. to inject a mock in tests or add a custom HTTP handler). If not provided, a default instance is created automatically.

WithPresence(string activityName, int activityType, string status, string streamUrl)

Sets the bot's initial presence shown immediately after the gateway READY event.

ParameterDescription
activityNameActivity text shown in the user list (e.g. "with fire").
activityTypeActivity type integer: 0 = Playing (default), 1 = Streaming, 2 = Listening, 3 = Watching, 5 = Competing.
statusDiscord status: "online" (default), "idle", "dnd", or "invisible".
streamUrlStream URL required when is 1 (Streaming).

Build()

Validates configuration and constructs a fully wired .
